about: Where Slack's New line goes and where an unread conversation opens. A timeline is a list of items: "marker" is the SDK's read marker, "hidden" an item the conversation doesn't show (a day divider, a message still sending, a membership change), and anything else the event ID of a message it shows. The line goes above the first shown message after the marker. An unread conversation opens at its fully-read event, the room's m.fully_read; one only marked unread by hand has nothing to resume. Room fields are as in unread-badge.json, plus fullyRead.

line.name: The line goes above the first shown message after the read marker
Without a read marker there is no line
With nothing after the marker there is no line
With only hidden items after the marker there is no line

resume.name: An unread conversation opens at its fully-read event
A conversation only marked unread has nothing to resume
A read conversation opens at its newest message
An invitation has nothing to resume
Without a fully-read event it opens at its newest message
A transaction ID is never an anchor
A bare sigil is never an anchor
An ID with a control character is never an anchor
